hero:
Use case: illustration-story. Reference image is the approved Xiao E collectible card. Keep EXACT mascot identity and the same fresh clean comic aesthetic: huge cream-white rounded helmet, dark navy rounded visor with two cyan inward-facing chevron eyes and NO mouth, concentric turquoise/white ear modules, short round turquoise crest, white suit and cape with turquoise edging, turquoise four-point chest insignia, dark boots, exactly two arms and two legs. Clean confident dark-teal outlines, simple light cel-shading, cream #FFFDF5, mint #DCF4E9, sky blue #C5E5F7, turquoise #42BCAF, tiny butter-yellow accents. Absolutely no grunge, splatter, grain, dense dots, dark space backdrop, caption, lettering, pseudo-text, numerals, logos, watermark, UI labels or speech bubbles.
Asset: the HERO character cutout for a large 80x180cm Chinese exhibition board. Redraw the mascot from the card as a polished full-body transparent cutout. Xiao E leaps diagonally upward toward the viewer with one friendly hand extended, a strong yet cute foreshortened pose, the second arm swept behind, two short boots in motion, and its cream cape flowing to the right. Include one thin turquoise orbit swoosh looping behind the mascot and only two little four-point sparkles; all negative space is truly transparent. No planet or background or shadow. Keep all limbs and cape tips fully inside the image with 8% clear padding. The character should occupy about 80% of a square canvas. Export one high-resolution square artwork, ideally 2048x2048 pixels, with genuine alpha transparency, not a checkerboard or opaque white rectangle. This is an illustration asset, NOT a poster, not a card mockup and not a 3D toy render.

Asset: COMIC SCENE 01, "understanding the learner", for a Chinese product exhibition poster. Draw one narrative vignette on genuine transparent background, wide 2:1 canvas, ideally 2400x1200 pixels. Xiao E stands on the RIGHT half, thoughtfully observing a floating circular learning constellation on the LEFT half. The constellation has exactly three large softly colored disks joined by thin turquoise arcs: one holds a simple open-book pictogram, one a target pictogram, and one a small clock pictogram, representing foundation, goal and pace. These are plain recognizable icons without words or numerals. Xiao E raises one mitten gently toward the diagram. The white cape, face eyes and four-point chest insignia remain visible; full body and two boots, no extra limb. Only a small cream/mint ground swoosh beneath the feet, not a physical pedestal or full background. Friendly discovery, clean readable composition, generous space between shapes, objects fully contained with 8% padding. This is one isolated landscape scene, no panel border, no poster layout, no lettering, no speech bubble and no UI. Keep the icons much simpler than the mascot so the scene reads at small scale.

Asset: COMIC SCENE 02, "your personal learning route", for the exhibition board. One isolated wide 2:1 narrative vignette, ideally 2400x1200 pixels, genuine transparent background. Xiao E is on the LEFT, in a three-quarter front view, pointing with one mitten toward a curving branching constellation on the RIGHT. The constellation contains only five simple softly colored round nodes; one is an open book icon, the next selected one is a brilliant but clean four-point yellow/teal star, and the remaining nodes are plain mint/sky-blue dots. Connect them with two thin curved paths showing a clear chosen route and one pale alternate branch. No numbered nodes, no text or UI labels. The raised hand is near the selected star but doesn't cover it. Dynamic cape subtly follows the route; full mascot, two hands and two boots, no extra arms. Use clear wide spacing, cream, mint and sky-blue flat accents, dark-teal outlines, simple cel-shading. No particles, no grunge or ground texture, no strong glow; only one clean tiny ellipse below the feet. Keep the whole vignette contained with 8% transparent padding. No border, no poster typography, no extra people or mascot duplicates.
